## DocumentResourceClient.get() method

Read the document identified by `name`<!-- -->. When several documents share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used, and the operation does not fail as ambiguous.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(name: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<Document>;
```
